title: Astreon: Lance of Taixu
subtitle: Soul Knight Prequel 1.13.0 (SS9): the Lance of Taixu build for Astreon (司星), in full detail
byline: Build from the top TapTap Astreon guide (一羽, SS9, updated 09/22; about 6-7 京 on the training dummy, floor 1000 in 29 s), matched to the game's own item, affix and skill text. Hover or tap an underlined keyword to see its in-game rules.
reading_note: Rows run **best first, left to right**. The first card in each row is the guide's pick; the rest are its stand-ins. The guide wrote Chinese names, and each is shown with the in-game English name. Anything the data could not resolve is marked **unresolved** and listed at the end under "Still to fill in".
tldr: **The build:** keep Amaranthine Starsigil locked in its Ravenous Wolf state so that every cast throws a Lance of Taixu, then multiply the Lances.
**Empyrean Sea** (沧澜云汉) is the weapon that does the locking. Put Ravenous Wolf and the Lance on auto-cast, and Calamitous Echocasting recasts both.
The **Domain of Taixu** Sacred Soul (4 pieces) makes an Astral General hurl a Colossal Lance every few Lances, and each enemy it pierces spawns more Lances.

**Stat targets:** passive crit plus panel crit = **100%**. Block, damage reduction and dodge **20% or more each**, to switch on the Celestial Auspice / Terrestrial Vantage / Concord of the Masses affixes. Skill CD speed **150%+** before Calamity Onslaught.
**One copy of each named affix:** the guide warns that a non-stat affix works only once however many items carry it, so never put the same one on two items.

items.text: **Lock the Starsigil on Ravenous Wolf.** Amaranthine Starsigil normally alternates between Ravenous Wolf (throws a Lance of Taixu) and Army Breaker (an Astral General strikes). Empyrean Sea locks it on Ravenous Wolf for good, so every cast is a Lance.

**Auto-cast both.** Set Ravenous Wolf **and** the Lance of Taixu skill to auto-cast, so both throw Lances on cooldown (the guide: "贪狼和太虚枪都开自动施法双扔枪"). Calamitous Echocasting recasts a skill at intervals, which the guide describes as doubling the throw rate.

**Snowball the Lances.** The throw rate triggers the Domain of Taixu Sacred Soul. Every few Lances an Astral General hurls a **Colossal** Lance at the enemy with the most max life, and each enemy it pierces summons another Lance in a random direction. The guide says this split is what keeps floor clearing fast.
**Crit on every hit.** Passive crit plus panel crit must reach 100%. Anode Helm, Ring of Lucent Elpis and Polar Extremes all scale off crits and $xianyao$ stacks, and the Lance deals Light damage.
**Swap one spec node per activity.** **Magnalume** for farming floors (bigger Lances). **Lumegyration** for bosses, or whenever you are short on damage.

items.note: The build's main button, on **auto-cast**. With Empyrean Sea it stays on **Ravenous Wolf**, so each cast is a Lance with bonus damage.
**Grandvoid's Lumenfall** (太虚落曜) is the Lance of Taixu skill, also on **auto-cast**. The Lance counts as a **summoned minion**, pierces everything in its path, and deals Light damage.

blocks.title: Sacred Soul: Domain of Taixu (4) + Valkyrie’s Verdict (2)

items.note: **4-piece bonus**, values read off a top Astreon's Sacred Soul panel (IMG_6322). The **2-piece** bonus is Awakened Skill CD Speed +10%. Its other tiers add Lance damage per Soul Power (`191265`) and, for every enemy the Colossal Lance pierces, one more Lance (`191266`).
**The last 2 slots.** The guide only says "any damage 2-piece"; the top Astreon on the leaderboard runs **Valkyrie's Verdict**: **2-piece: Dmg to Elites +15%**.

Linking it to Empyrean Sea comes from the guide, not from a codex screenshot. A top Astreon wears it (see "As worn" below).
Each $xianyao$ stack adds Light damage to a **crit**. At 100% crit, that is every Lance hit.

blocks.text: One panel per slot, in the game's item-detail order: **Prefix** stats, then **Suffix** (Special Affixes in gold, forged-in legendary effects in purple; both go only into suffix slots), then **Celesturgic** (天工, red). " / " means any one of them. Hover or tap a named affix to see its effect where the game text has it. Everything comes from the TapTap guide: prefix and suffix from its text, Celesturgic from its chart images.

**Two rules from the guide.** 1) "所有文字类词条（非加成词）同名只可生效一次，不要多打": a named, non-stat affix counts **once** across all your gear, so never put the same one on two items. 2) Get block, damage reduction and dodge to **20% or more each** on your panel. Celestial Auspice, Terrestrial Vantage and Concord of the Masses only reach full strength above a threshold ("吃满天时/地利/人和").

**Progression:** Boar King → Medusa → **Hades (best)**. items.note: **Hades, the endgame pick.** Chthonic Descent: attacked enemies take True Damage based on their max life and take more damage. Underlord's Summons keeps it on for the whole fight.
**Medusa**, the step before Hades.
**Boar King**, the first step. Its Axial Heart effect text is not linked in the data.

limits: Source: one TapTap guide (一羽, "【SS9攻略】司星太虚枪毕业攻略", edited 09/22, September 2026), checked against the 1.13.0 game text. In this APK Astreon's skill descriptions sit 1004 keys after their names, not 1000; the designers' skill labels confirm this, and the page uses that offset. The Special Affix texts use the documented Forged Affix layout (text at N, name at N+1). Nothing in the data links Empyrean Sea to its effect, so that link is the guide's. The `?` values live in the encrypted config. Nothing here was tested in game.
